blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water Foundation’s Luntiang La Mesa program continues to transform environmental stewardship into meaningful action, planting 13,068 native and endemic trees through sustained partnerships with public and private organizations, schools, and institutions Luntiang La Mesa clocked 25,593 volunteer hours across 84 organizational engagements from June to October 2026, transforming environmental stewardship into a structured, multi-sectoral effort focused on restoring native habitats, promoting “biodiverCity” or biodiversity in the city, and strengthening watershed protection. Rather than relying on one-time ceremonial tree-planting activities, La Mesa Ecopark anchored its reforestation campaign on continuing partnerships that encouraged organizations to take an active role in […]...
